notes.title: More challengers needed!
notes.content:
Two new challengers have appeared on the leaderboard, will they be able to take the top spot before workout Season ends on 10/31?  Can you beat their scores?  Play now!  

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1052140/Function_World_Gym/]Function World Gym[/url]

notes.title: Season 1 Update
notes.content: Season 1 Update:  I finished another workout, raising my score and putting me on top of the world leaderboard.  I challenge you to beat it before the season ends at the end of the month!

notes.title: Updated Layouts!
notes.content: Updated layouts including a new Motivation Wall to include inspiring quotes and community success stories.  What would you want on it to inspire others?

notes.title: New Feature: Community Spotlight!
notes.content:
New Feature: Community Spotlight!
Highlighting positive stories of progress from our community, because you deserve to be recognized.  Post your fitness gaming journey to Function World Gym's social media and you might get highlighted!

notes.title: Updated lighting
notes.content: Updated the platform with improved lighting and better contrast on the information panels for reading.

notes.title: Function World Gym Seasons are now open!
notes.content:
Function World Gym Seasons are now open!

Message from DocScott:  I've designed workout challenges, can you beat my high score while maintaining proper movement form?  Can you take the top leaderboard spot before the season ends?  The winner will be added to the Hall of Heroes!

notes.title: Today's updates
notes.content: Today's updates:  There are improved instructions on how to line up your playspace in VR for working out, and a new format to the Air Squats workout.  Check it out!

notes.title: Function Updates
notes.content: Function has new updates including environment performance upgrades and a new format to how the levels work.

notes.title: Function World Gym is Free To Play!
notes.content: Function World Gym officially is Free To Play as of today!  All players should remove any playtest versions from their Steam library and get the latest version of the main title once changes over at 10:00AM Pacific time.  Let's keep Function growing together into the future of gamified fitness!

notes.title: Updated Nature Background Screenshot
notes.content: Nature workout motivation!  New screenshot of one of Function World Gym's background environments that will power your motivation through the next workout.  Available soon. How does nature inspire you?

notes.title: Nature = Motivation
notes.content: Research supports improved mood and motivation when being around nature, so Function World Gym is working on bringing that nature to you for your workouts.  What motivates you?

notes.title: Function World Gym is Growing Up!
notes.content: Function World Gym is growing up!  The platform will convert from paid to free-to-play soon, improving the platform at a faster rate as the supportive community grows with it.  If you are one of the original purchasers, email us by 10/6/2021 at imminnllc@gmail.com to let us know with your Steam name and what name you prefer to be listed as on the recognition wall.  You will be put on the VIP list for the future, which includes free upgrades and having your name listed in-game for recognition of your work.  You invested in Function early on and that investment needs to be recognized, thanks!

notes.title: Ball Pit work continues...
notes.content: Work continues on the BallPit app, working on adding a giant ballpit where players knock the balls out of the pit for points.

notes.title: Constructor app update!
notes.content: Constructor app updated with new block sizes and improved ability to grip objects!

notes.title: New mini-game under construction: Ball Pit!
notes.content: Starting construction on a new mini-game called Ball Pit.  Accessible from the main menu but not much there to see yet!

notes.title: New Mini-App: Constructor!
notes.content: New Mini-App: Constructor!  Squat to build the score, unlocking building blocks of different shapes to build whatever you want!  More squats = bigger constructions! Thank you everyone for helping grow the community!

notes.title: New app under construction - Constructor!
notes.content: New app under construction - Constructor.  Squat to earn points and then use those points to unlock building blocks to build anything you want.  More squats, more blocks!

notes.title: New Exit Game Mini-App!
notes.content: Sun update: New Exit Game mini-app!  If you want a more interactive way to exit, choose easy or harder ways to leave.  Earn that exit!

notes.title: Updated Menu System!
notes.content: Updated Menu System!  Activities are now grouped into apps that the player can choose from a giant floating tablet.  Choose one and it warps you right on into the action!  Thank you for the support!

notes.title: New Mini-Games Pie Eater and Whittler!
notes.content:
New game added, Pie Eater!  So hungry, how fast can you clear the board by grabbing and eating all of the pie pieces?

[previewyoutube=Nh3AjNuYNSM;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]











New mini-game added, Whittler!  Use your hands to carve the colored cubes into any shape you want.  Contains over 1300 little cubes, very soothing!

[previewyoutube=C18NCfVwjL8;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Explosions update!
notes.content: Explosions have been added to scoring points in mini-games and fitness areas.  Add some flare to your points gathering style.  Getting a high score has never been more fun, check it out!

notes.title: Small patch: Internet Music Player
notes.content:
Updated the internet music player so that it populates the radio station list correctly.  If you are experiencing issues with the internet music player playing the wrong stations, do the following to fix it:
1. Update Function
2. Delete the Radios_user.txt in this directory on your computer: 
C:\Users\(YOUR USER NAME)\AppData\LocalLow\Immersive Innovations\Function
3. Launch Function, it should be fixed!

notes.title: New Custom Music Player!
notes.content: A custom music player has been added to Function!  Play your own music files to listen to anything you want while you play.  Thank you to everyone for helping make Function a huge success!

notes.title: Update: New layout and music integration!
notes.content: Update: Function now has an improved layout AND integrated internet radio stations!  Flip on the tunes and rock out as you explore an ever-expanding library of mini-games, timed workouts and open gym setups.  More content coming soon, thanks for helping make Function a huge success!

notes.title: New Mini-Game: SledgeBoom!
notes.content: Meet SledgeBoom, a new mini-game added to Function.  Grab the hammer, smash the targets, but don't hit the wrong ones!

notes.title: New Tutorial and Mini-Game!
notes.content: Function has been updated with a new tutorial scene and a new mini game called Use Your Noggin'.  Catch the points with your head, but avoid the spikes.  Check it out today!

notes.title: Upgraded menu system
notes.content: A new menu system including laser pointers has been installed.  As Function grows with new content, the upgraded menu system will allow content to be more easy organized so players can find exactly what they are looking for.  Thank you to the community for the continued support!

notes.title: Updated Ranking and Leaderboards
notes.content: Morning everyone!  Leaderboard interface for activities has an improved layout.  Worldwide rank and Top 10 Leaderboards are now active.  Compete against the Function community for the top level.  Entries are cumulative, persistence counts!

notes.title: Worldwide ranking is now active!
notes.content: User ranks are now active!  Choose an activity, level up and compete worldwide against the Function community for the top spot!

notes.title: New homebase layout!
notes.content: Updating the menu system and aesthetic layout today for improved flow.  Check out the changes and let us know what you think!  Thank you to the community for your support!

notes.title: Party Games in development!
notes.content: Feedback was received to develop the creative fun factor in the activities on Function.  Based on this, work is being put into a new section called Party Games which will be made up of fun mini-games with leaderboards.  Check out the first installment Use Your Noggin', more to come!  Thank you to the community for your support of Function!

notes.title: Leveling up is now live!
notes.content: Leveling up is now live!  Players can now see their level progress for each category in their homebase, choose an activity and workout to increase their level.  More activities will be added over time, as well as leaderboards for each so players can see how their level compares to the world.  Thank you to everyone for supporting Function!

notes.title: New Function Homebase is Live!
notes.content: The new Function homebase is now live!  Players will find an improved layout allowing selection of activities based on their interest areas.  The team is still working on implementing statistics and leaderboards, so those are marked under construction inside of the game for now.  This new setup will allow an easy way to add new content in the future to cover a range of needs from activities for strengthening to lowering back pain.  Thank you to the community for the continued support!

notes.title: Teleport bugs fixed
notes.content: Saturday update:  Fixed some teleporting bugs that caused players to not be able to teleport in certain areas in the arena, hopefully that should be fixed now.  Next up: Making some needed edits to the Steam store and trailer.  Have a great weekend everyone!

notes.title: Workouts now enabled!
notes.content: Friday update: All workout levels are updated and available today!  Trial timed workouts ranging from Power to Endurance to the massive Titan workout.  Post your time or your arena highscore for the leaderboard.  Thanks to everyone for your support, you make Function possible.  Next steps:  Fixing some teleporting mechanic bugs.  Future: More activity stations and getting stats and Steam leaderboards integrated.  Happy Friday!

notes.title: Thursday update: New reaction punching setup
notes.content: Thursday update: Working on getting the timed workout levels back up and working.  Reaction punching activity station is updated with new spawning locations of the targets so that things aren't so far away and aren't so low, check it out!  Thanks to everyone via the various mediums for their feedback so far.  Check out the in-game leaderboard, a couple new names on it!  Next steps:  Keep working on the timed workout levels.  Future plans:  Tons of more activity stations and auto-updating stats and leaderboards!

notes.title: Fitness workout level now available!
notes.content: Wednesday update:  The "Fitness" workout level is updated with the latest interaction mechanics.  Check it out in the main play area and let us know if you see any bugs, thanks!

notes.title: Interaction system update
notes.content: The updated interaction system is complete and ready for testing!  Thanks to everyone for their patience as we worked on the compatibility problems.  Function should now work for all VR headsets connecting to SteamVR and all interaction mechanics should work, including teleportation.  The update comes with a couple additional features we received feedback on, including snap-turning and articulating hands instead of static controllers models for hands.  In addition, teleporting is simpler to do (thanks martyrob for the feedback) via using the directional controls, no more pushing buttons.  Timed workouts are turned off right now, but will be turned back on as we update each individual level.  Please try it out and let us know if something doesn't work so we can continue improving!

notes.title: Updating the interaction system
notes.content: Finished work on the home base arena for the new interaction system.  Next step is to convert the game intro scene over and then the game should be ready for updating to Steam for testing.  I'll send updates as we progress, thanks!

notes.title: Starting scene re-design
notes.content: Today the game's starting scene was redesigned for improved usage.  Modeled after what other top VR titles do, it has a simple billboard layout with important information for the player to look at and then they can select to start the game.  Thanks to everyone for the continued feedback!

notes.title: Function Arena and Weekly Leaderboards Now Open!
notes.content:
Hi team, players asked for an easier way to do exercises besides structured, timed workouts.  Based on this feedback Function now has two ways to play:

Function Arena:  Gain the highest score using any combination of exercises you want.

Function Workouts:  Race to the finish line in structured, timed workouts.

Weekly Leaderboard:  The highest scores and fastest times posted in the Function Discord or Function Community Facebook group will be listed in the game!

New content constantly being added to the Arena, check it out!

notes.title: New exercise: Find the buried points
notes.content: Added a new experimental exercise today called Find The Buried Points.  Check it out in the Development Area in Function and give feedback to improve it, thanks!  -DocScott

notes.title: New experimental exercise: Sliders
notes.content: Working on adding more exercises and more workout types.  Added a new experimental exercise to the Development Area called Sliders.  Join us on Function Community on Facebook or Function on Discord, feedback appreciated!

notes.title: 7/3/2020 Update
notes.content:
Feedback being received:  More exercise types.

What we are working on:  Started a line of Reaction Training exercises and added a prototype new one called Floating Away.  Check it out in the Development Area and give feedback!

notes.title: 7/2/2020 Update
notes.content:
Hi all, here is a summary of what we have been working on.  Please give feedback on Function Discord or Function Community Facebook group to continue to improve Function.  Thanks!

Feedback received:
-Use Discord, some players prefer that over Facebook
-Start creating more workout types that focus on lot of different things
-Get players faster access to content the development team is working on so players can play around with it and give feedback as work is being done.

Actions taken:
-Function is live on Discord.
-More types of workouts will be created in the future, starting with Reaction Training and Party Games
-A new Development Area is added to the home area in the game.  New experimental content will be added there as the team works on it.  Not everything might work but it will give players a constant view of what the team is up to and allow players to discuss it to help improve it.

Thanks all for your continued support!

notes.title: Function is LAUNCHED!
notes.content:
Function is officially launched in early access on Steam today, click the link and join Function now!

Thank you to the overwhelming support from the community to make this happen.  Cheers to everyone coming together.  Now we move forward to make Function the amazing platform it deserves to be.  Looking forward to working with all of you!

-DocScott
